# Entretien Auto

Entretien Auto is a simple, private car maintenance tracker, now packaged as a real Muse skill. Log oil changes, brake jobs, tires, inspections and repairs in a dated history with mileage and cost, and check what is likely due from the recorded intervals, starting with oil every 8,000 km or 6 months. Your vehicle profile and log stay in a data folder you own: no account, no cloud, no ads.

The listing installs the packaged SKILL.md and LICENSE from Skill Harbor's public house-skills repository. It is a Skill Harbor house build, free to use under the proprietary Skill Harbor House License v1.0, all rights reserved. The skill checks due items when you ask or report a service; it does not by itself create background notifications.
